changelog:
- Adds a PassSlot skill for managing Apple Wallet passes through an OOMOL-connected PassSlot account.
- Supports listing pass types, templates, and existing passes.
- Supports reading pass installation URLs and current placeholder values.
- Supports creating passes from templates and updating placeholder values with schema-driven payloads.
